darkModeSub: Switch between light and dark themes
heroHeadline:
Find a place.
Make it yours.
heroSub: A simpler way to discover, compare and connect with property across Kenya.
missionBody: Property Konnect aims to make property discovery easier, more connected and more convenient for people across Kenya.
whoWeServeSub: One app for everyone looking for, or offering, a place to live or work.
studentsBody: Find hostels near your campus, connect with roommates, use student services and join campus communities in the Student Hub.
tenantsBuyersBody: Search by county and subcounty, compare options and contact owners directly.
propertyOwnersBody: List your property and reach people who are actively looking for a place.
whatYouCanFindSub: Choose Rent or Buy, then tap a category to see matching properties.
whereWeCoverSub: Property across all counties. Pick a county to see its subcounties.
journeySub: From finding a property to making it home.
whyWideSub: Homes, hostels, apartments, commercial space and more.
whyVerifiedSub: Listings are reviewed before they go live.
whyMobileSub: Designed to work smoothly on your phone.
whySmartSub: Filter by county, subcounty, type and purpose.
whySafeSub: Report suspicious listings and read our safety tips.
safetyBody1: Before sending money to a property owner, personally tour the property and make sure you are comfortable with the transaction and its details.
safetyBody2: If you notice something suspicious about a listing, you can report it using the report option available on its property details page.
studentSectionBody: Student Hub brings together student-friendly accommodation, roommate connections, student services and campus communities.
verifyIntro: We will send a verification link to your email. Tap Verify Email, then click the link in the email. This page will continue automatically.
waitingForClick: Waiting for you to click the link. This page will continue automatically.
tapVerifyToSend: Tap Verify Email to send the verification link.
checkSpam: Check your spam/junk folder if you do not see the email.
linkSent: A verification link has been sent to your email.
linkInvalid: This link is invalid or has expired. Please request a new one.
couldNotSend: Could not send the email. Check your connection and try again.
tooManyRequests: Too many requests. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
